name: Jan-v1-4B vLLM Server
description: Optimized vLLM server for Jan-v1-4B model
onstart_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Kill any existing vLLM processes
pkill -f 'vllm serve' || true
sleep 2

echo '🚀 Starting Jan-v1-4B vLLM server...'

# Create models directory
mkdir -p /workspace/models

# Start vLLM with Jan-v1-4B
if command -v vllm &> /dev/null; then
    # Use vllm CLI if available
    vllm serve janhq/Jan-v1-4B \
        --max-model-len 2048 \
        --dtype auto \
        --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
        --download-dir /workspace/models \
        --host 0.0.0.0 \
        --port 8000 \
        --served-model-name jan-v1-4b &
else
    # Fallback to Python module
    python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
        --model janhq/Jan-v1-4B \
        --max-model-len 2048 \
        --dtype auto \
        --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
        --download-dir /workspace/models \
        --host 0.0.0.0 \
        --port 8000 \
        --served-model-name jan-v1-4b &
fi

echo '✅ vLLM server started in background'
echo '⏳ Model loading... (this may take 2-3 minutes)'
echo '🌐 API will be available at http://<IP>:8000/v1'

# Keep container running
tail -f /dev/null
